value.title: Human-player count
value.selection_rationale: This term has a specific game meaning that affects interpretation and is reused by the requirements.

content.meaning: The number of human-controlled marks in a game: zero, one or two. Zero players means zero human players; X and O still exist and are controlled by AI.

changes.rationale: Introduce this source-backed meaning into the empty repository Canon.

value.title: Unbeatable AI
value.selection_rationale: This term has a specific game meaning that affects interpretation and is reused by the requirements.

content.meaning: A computer-controlled player. Unbeatable means no loss from a fresh legal game against any legal opponent sequence as either X or O. A draw is valid, not a guarantee of victory. Two unbeatable AIs draw under standard rules. This does not select an algorithm or external AI service.

changes.rationale: Introduce this source-backed meaning into the empty repository Canon.

value.title: Game
value.selection_rationale: This term has a specific game meaning that affects interpretation and is reused by the requirements.

content.meaning: One standard 3x3 round from an empty board until X wins, O wins or a draw. It is distinct from a browser session and implies no match or multi-game score.

changes.rationale: Introduce this source-backed meaning into the empty repository Canon.

value.title: Play again
value.selection_rationale: This term has a specific game meaning that affects interpretation and is reused by the requirements.

content.meaning: Play again is a person's explicit action beginning another game after termination. In zero-human mode the person triggers replay without controlling either mark. Replay is not automatic.

changes.rationale: Introduce this source-backed meaning into the empty repository Canon.

value.title: Rules
value.selection_rationale: This is independently observable game behavior required by the cited sources and retained planning interpretation.

content.obligation: Use nine cells in a 3x3 board. X starts; X and O alternate, placing one mark in an empty cell. Three identical marks in a row, column or diagonal win. A full board without a winner draws. A winning final move takes precedence over draw; terminal games accept no moves.
content.rationale: Required behavior for the selected standard game and interaction modes.
content.acceptance_direction: All eight winning lines for both marks; Full-board draw and winning ninth move; Occupied-cell rejection, X-first alternation and terminal immutability

changes.rationale: Introduce this source-backed meaning into the empty repository Canon.

value.title: Playable local React tic-tac-toe with verified unbeatable AI
value.outcome: One cohesive delivery of the browser-held game, local Express serving on 3630, exhaustive correctness/AI tests and actual Chrome desktop/iPhone acceptance. Internal tasks are not separately reserved phases.
included: Standard rules and all human-player modes
Explicit Start and active setup lock
Manual replay in every mode with current settings
React served by local Node.js/Express on 3630
excluded: Framework helper changes as product work
acceptance: Rules cover all eight win lines for X/O, full draw, final-cell win precedence, X-first alternation, occupied cells and terminal immutability.

Explore every legal opponent sequence against AI-X and AI-O, all permitted nondeterministic choices, legal returned moves and zero AI losses. Use an independent outcome oracle or assertions separate from the engine being tested. AI/AI must draw.
All modes remain inactive before Start. One-human mode accepts input only for the human turn; two-human mode schedules no AI moves; zero-human play needs no board input after Start.

Controlled clocks verify no move before 500 ms and exactly one legal move for the scheduled turn, including openings and successive AI/AI turns. Cover rapid input, stacked timers, termination and stale prior-game callbacks.
Lock mode/mark during play; unlock at completion. Changing terminal setup alone does not start moves. Play again starts directly with displayed selections, X first and no duplicate game.
Each reachable terminal result persists until a new-game action. Replay clears board/result, retains mode/mark and isolates old callbacks.
Verify browser-owned state and independent sessions without move APIs, authentication claims, saved games or persistent scores. No offline-loading guarantee is inferred.
Load real React assets and play through port 3630; occupied port fails clearly. Verify actual phone/LAN URL without assuming phone localhost or changing firewall/public exposure without authority.

Complete/replay games in actual desktop Chrome and actual Chrome on the physical iPhone. Exercise touch/pointer input, setup, Start, AI observation, result retention, full board/control fit, hit targets and stable non-overlapping layout.

Record device, OS, browser versions, viewport, URL, tested commit, observed outcomes, dependency versions, commands, automated results, AI exploration method/counts and untested cases. Screenshots support but do not replace interaction evidence.

tasks.text: Inspect repository conventions, packages/tests and compatible dependencies. Evaluate a suitable maintained game/AI library for license, browser compatibility, footprint, rules and unbeatable behavior. If none is suitable, request an explicit tradeoff decision rather than silently writing a custom engine.
Integrate rules/AI and independently verify legal transitions and no losses for either AI mark. Internal API choices remain implementation decisions.
Implement React setup, Start, controller ownership, turn/result display, 500 ms AI turns, manual replay and cancellation or rejection of stale callbacks. Add behavior/component tests.
Serve built React assets through Express on 3630. Document run commands and deliberate LAN access; verify occupied-port refusal.
Verify the integrated application automatically and on actual desktop Chrome and physical-iPhone Chrome. Record exact implementation and environment evidence.

risks: A purported unbeatable library needs exhaustive independent verification
Stale or duplicate scheduled moves can corrupt replay and terminal state
Desktop emulation cannot prove iPhone Chrome behavior
LAN serving must remain deliberate local use without unauthorized network changes
later_contract_obligations: Resolve actual implementation placement/toolchain before naming paths
Provide the required validated architecture/pre-flight diagram when creating a complete phase prompt for these boundaries
Fresh exact baseline and independent review/decision are still required before admission
supplemental_checks: Suggested automated viewports: 1280x800 desktop, 390x844 mobile, 320px-width stress
engineering recommendations, adjustable with rationale; not claimed device dimensions
Firefox, Safari, Android, Chromium emulation and WebKit checks are optional and cannot replace required actual Chrome desktop/iPhone evidence
